inventory.visualPurpose: Special culture requirements — the bug-to-medium directory table
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The printed 3-column table (BUG / MEDIA USED FOR ISOLATION / MEDIA CONTENTS-OTHER) with 10 rows: H influenzae (chocolate), N gonorrhoeae + N meningitidis (Thayer-Martin), B pertussis (Bordet-Gengou / Regan-Lowe), C diphtheriae (tellurite / Löffler), M tuberculosis (LJ / Middlebrook / rapid broth), M pneumoniae (Eaton), lactose-fermenting enterics (MacConkey), E coli (EMB), Brucella + Francisella + Legionella + Pasteurella (BCYE), Fungi (Sabouraud).
inventory.kypLocation: blocks[0] visual + blocks[1] note-block (the visual reorganizes the table by medium job; the table block carries it verbatim)

notes: Census: pure vector page, no printed figures. The single source visual is the directory table itself — redrawn as ONE original KYP registry visual (bug-media-matching-map, job-organized) and carried verbatim as the note's table block. FA's printed mnemonics not reproduced in the visual.
